ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a visitor who keeps their distance

texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} stopped a few steps short of {A_nameDef} and stayed there, and when {A_nameDef} offered a cup, {X_pronoun} said no thank you. With {SITUATION} in {SITUATIONPLACE}, {X_pronoun} said, everyone on the road keeps their distance.

{X_nameDef} talked with {A_nameDef} from across the path, a cloth pulled up over {X_possessive} mouth. Nobody on the road sits close to anyone this season, {X_pronoun} said, not with {SITUATION} about.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a visitor asks after the fever

texts.li: Before {X_nameDef} would sit down, {X_pronoun} asked {A_nameDef} whether anyone at the colony had the fever. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} how things stood, and {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} how they stood at {SITUATIONPLACE}, which was worse.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} wanted to know whether {SITUATION} had come this way yet. {A_nameDef} answered as honestly as {A_pronoun} could, and {X_nameDef} thanked {A_objective} for not pretending.
{A_nameDef} saw {X_nameDef} slip food from the colony's stores into {X_possessive} pack, and let it go. With {SITUATION} at {SITUATIONPLACE}, {A_nameDef} said afterwards, nobody should have to ask.

{A_nameDef} caught {X_nameDef} slipping food from the colony's stores into {X_possessive} pack. {X_nameDef} went red and started to put it back, but {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} to keep it, with {SITUATION} on at {SITUATIONPLACE}.
{X_nameDef}, the trader, asked {A_nameDef} whether the colony had any grain to sell. With {SITUATION} at {SITUATIONPLACE}, {X_pronoun} said, grain is worth more than silver this year.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that every cart on the road is carrying food to {SITUATIONPLACE} or coming back empty. {X_pronoun} would buy any grain the colony could spare, and pay well for it.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked {A_nameDef} where the colony's water was. Since {SITUATION}, {X_pronoun} said, every well on the road has a queue at it, and some have a guard.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that the stream at {SITUATIONPLACE} is down to mud. {A_nameDef} showed {X_objective} where to fill {X_possessive} waterskin.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a pilgrim kneels at the colony's holy place

texts.li: {X_nameDef}, on the road to {SITUATIONPLACE} for {SITUATION}, asked {A_nameDef} whether the colony had a holy place. {A_nameDef} pointed the way, and {X_nameDef} went to kneel there a while.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} saw the colony's holy place and asked {A_nameDef} whether a pilgrim might kneel there. {A_nameDef} said yes, and {X_nameDef} went straight to it.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a pilgrim's prayer for a colonist

texts.li: {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}'s name, to say it in a prayer at {SITUATIONPLACE}. {A_nameDef} spelled it out twice to be sure {X_pronoun} had it right.
Before going on toward {SITUATIONPLACE}, {X_nameDef} offered to carry a prayer there for {A_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} thought about it for a while, then told {X_objective} what to pray for.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: two sides of a war at one fire

texts.li: [fire] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} and {B_nameDef}, of the other side in {SITUATION}, ended up at the same fire. {A_nameDef} watched them warm their hands a few feet apart. Neither of them said a word about the war, and {A_nameDef} didn't ask.
[fire] {A_nameDef} found {X_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sitting at the colony's fire. Their peoples are at war, and they both knew it, but it was the only fire and they both stayed.

[heater] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} and {B_nameDef}, whose peoples are at war in {SITUATION}, sat at the same heater without looking at each other. {A_nameDef} kept an eye on them, but they stayed quiet.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} stood outside in the dark and looked for the comet over the hills. {X_nameDef} said that at {SITUATIONPLACE} they ring a bell every night it shows.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} pointed the comet out to {A_nameDef}, low in the sky with its tail behind it. They stood and watched it together until the cold sent them in.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} showed {A_nameDef} a ribbon {X_pronoun} won at the fair at {SITUATIONPLACE}, for the best cheese. {A_nameDef} said it must have been very good cheese.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} a ribbon from the fair at {SITUATIONPLACE}: second place in the wrestling. {X_pronoun} says the winner cheated.
[x:child] {X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} the ribbon {X_pronoun} won in the children's race at the fair at {SITUATIONPLACE}, and wanted to know whether the colony has races too.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a drover's dog and the hens

texts.li: {X_nameDef}'s dog spotted the colony's hens and went straight for them, and they scattered in every direction. {X_nameDef} apologised to {A_nameDef}: the dog has been driving herds all season and can't stop.

{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} were talking when {X_nameDef}'s dog ran off to round up the colony's hens. {X_nameDef} called it back, laughing, and said it thinks every flock on the road is its own this year.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a carter off the ice road warms up

texts.li: [fire] {X_nameDef} came in off the frozen road with frostnipped hands and asked {A_nameDef} whether {X_pronoun} might warm them at the colony's fire before going on. {A_nameDef} took {X_objective} to it.
[fire] {X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} hands red and stiff from holding the reins all the way from {SITUATIONPLACE}, and went to warm them at the colony's fire.
[heater] {X_nameDef} came in off the frozen road with frostnipped hands, and {A_nameDef} sent {X_objective} to stand by the heater for a while.

{X_nameDef} was humming a tune while {A_nameDef} worked nearby. It's the song about this colony that {SITUATION} has been singing on the road, {X_pronoun} said, and hummed it again so {A_nameDef} could learn it.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} hummed a few lines of the song about the colony for {A_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} said the part about the wall was not how it happened.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: the names of the dead said aloud

texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked {A_nameDef} to say the names of {X_possessive} people's dead aloud with {X_objective}, as they do at {SITUATIONPLACE} this season. {A_nameDef} said each one after {X_objective}.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about the people {SITUATIONPEOPLE} lost, one by one, and {A_nameDef} listened to all of it.
